description: Defines classes, structs, enums, and functions related to XPU memory allocation and caching, including XPUAllocator interface, memory segment management, trace entries, and MemPool class.

classes.name: XPUAllocator
classes.description: Abstract interface for XPU device memory allocators with init, raw_alloc, and raw_delete methods.

classes.name: BlockInfo
classes.description: Contains information about a memory block, including size, request size, GC counter, and allocation status.

classes.name: SegmentInfo
classes.description: Represents a contiguous device memory segment with details like device, address, size, blocks, and context.

classes.name: TraceEntry
classes.description: Records memory allocation, deallocation, and segment events with associated metadata.

classes.name: AllocatorConfigInfo
classes.description: Holds configuration details for the allocator, such as whether segments are expandable and last settings.

classes.name: SnapshotInfo
classes.description: Captures a snapshot of current memory segments, device traces, and allocator configuration.

classes.name: MemPool
classes.description: Represents a memory pool for XPU allocations, managing allocator, device, and pool ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the current global XPUAllocator instance.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the allocator with the number of devices.

methods.name: emptyCache
methods.description: Empties the allocator's cache for a given memory pool.

methods.name: resetPeakStats
methods.description: Resets peak memory statistics for a device.

methods.name: resetAccumulatedStats
methods.description: Resets accumulated memory statistics for a device.

methods.name: getDeviceStats
methods.description: Retrieves device statistics for a specified device.

methods.name: raw_alloc
methods.description: Allocates raw device memory of specified size.

methods.name: raw_delete
methods.description: Deletes raw device memory.

methods.name: recordStream
methods.description: Records a data stream for a data pointer.

methods.name: enablePeerAccess
methods.description: Enables peer access between devices.

methods.name: getMemoryFraction
methods.description: Gets the fraction of memory to use on a device.

methods.name: setMemoryFraction
methods.description: Sets the fraction of memory to use on a device.

methods.name: recordHistory
methods.description: Enables or disables recording of allocation history.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of current memory segments and traces.

methods.name: createOrIncrefPool
methods.description: Creates or increments reference count for a memory pool.

methods.name: beginAllocateToPool
methods.description: Begins allocation to a specific memory pool with a filter.

methods.name: endAllocateToPool
methods.description: Ends allocation to a specific memory pool.

methods.name: releasePool
methods.description: Releases a memory pool.

methods.name: getPoolUseCount
methods.description: Returns the usage count of a memory pool.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns the ID of the MemPool.

methods.name: allocator
methods.description: Returns the allocator associated with the MemPool.

methods.name: use_count
methods.description: Returns the usage count of the MemPool.

methods.name: device
methods.description: Returns the device index associated with the MemPool.

methods.name: graph_pool_handle
methods.description: Returns a handle for a graph memory pool, optionally creating a new one.
